claims.note: Driessen favors five signs and discusses ligature, later addition, or crowding at the start. His proposed Linear B-value rendering is tentative; only TA and TE receive relative security.
Davis proposes that the initial sign resembles AB67, while summarizing Driessen’s tentative initial reading as a ligature of AB13 and AB40.

comparison.qualification_delta: The original report retains three possibilities for the initial strokes. The later introduction foregrounds the ligature possibility. Preserve both levels of qualification; do not silently rewrite the first author’s position.
comparison.basis: Davis explicitly names PK Zb21 and cites the1991 publication; shared documentary subject only.
comparison.gorila_firewall: No GORILA content, source charts, comparative drawings or downstream reconstruction admitted. PK Zb21 was published after the GORILA volumes; these notes concern the two authors’ own discussion of that find.
